import json,csv,sys
E='$E'
J=json.load(open(E+'/metrics.json')); P=json.load(open(E+'/panel-dom.json'))
T={t['label']:t for t in P['tables']}
rows=0; cells=0; diffs=[]
def chk(name,ui,exp):
    global cells
    cells+=1
    if str(ui)!=str(exp): diffs.append((name,ui,exp))
def table(label): return {r['label']:r['cells'] for r in T[label]['rows'] if r['label']}
def c2(x): return f"{x:.2f}"
# roles
ut=table('usage-roles'); cr={r['role']:r for r in J['cost_by_role']}
for r in J['tokens_by_role']:
    rows+=1; c=ut['usage-role-'+r['role']]; k=r['role']
    chk(k+'.input',c[1],r['tokens']['input']);chk(k+'.output',c[2],r['tokens']['output']);chk(k+'.cache_read',c[3],r['tokens']['cache_read'])
    chk(k+'.cost',c[4],c2(cr[k]['cost']['amount']));chk(k+'.mult',c[5],f"{cr[k]['multiplier_key']} x{cr[k]['multiplier']:g}")
# lanes
ul=table('usage-lanes')
for r in J['tokens_by_lane']:
    rows+=1; c=ul['usage-lane-'+r['lane']]; k=r['lane']
    chk(k+'.input',c[1],r['tokens']['input']);chk(k+'.output',c[2],r['tokens']['output']);chk(k+'.cache_read',c[3],r['tokens']['cache_read']);chk(k+'.cost',c[4],c2(r['cost']['amount']))
# milestones (usage) vs json tokens_by_milestone and csv
um=table('usage-milestones')
csvrows={r['id']:r for r in csv.DictReader(open(E+'/metrics.csv')) if r['scope']=='milestone'}
for r in J['tokens_by_milestone']:
    rows+=1; k=r['milestone'] or '(none)'; c=um['usage-milestone-'+k]
    chk('ms.'+k+'.input',c[1],r['tokens']['input']);chk('ms.'+k+'.output',c[2],r['tokens']['output']);chk('ms.'+k+'.cache_read',c[3],r['tokens']['cache_read']);chk('ms.'+k+'.cost',c[4],c2(r['cost']['amount']))
    if k in csvrows:
        cs=csvrows[k]; chk('csv.'+k+'.cycle_s',c[5],cs['cycle_s']);chk('csv.'+k+'.rework_windows',c[6],cs['rework_windows']);chk('csv.'+k+'.cost_usd',c[4],c2(float(cs['cost_usd'])))
        chk('csv.'+k+'.tokens_input',c[1],cs['tokens_input']);chk('csv.'+k+'.tokens_output',c[2],cs['tokens_output']);chk('csv.'+k+'.tokens_cache_read',c[3],cs['tokens_cache_read'])
# waste tokens per cause
uw=table('usage-waste-tokens')
for cause,t in J['tokens_in_waste_by_cause'].items():
    if cause=='throttled': continue
    rows+=1; c=uw['usage-waste-'+cause]
    chk(cause+'.input',c[1],t['input']);chk(cause+'.output',c[2],t['output']);chk(cause+'.cache_read',c[3],t['cache_read'])
# five groups
G={'Waiting on human':['waiting_human_question','waiting_human_permission','waiting_merge'],'Waiting on validation':['waiting_validation'],'Rework':['rework'],'Retry':['retry_failure'],'Idle':['idle_queued','idle_unscheduled']}
for r in T['waste-groups']['rows']:
    if r['label']!='waste-group': continue
    g=r['cells'][0]; cs=G[g]; rows+=1
    chk(g+'.seconds',r['cells'][1],sum(J['mission']['waste_s'][x] for x in cs))
    for i,f in enumerate(['input','output','cache_read']): chk(g+'.tok.'+f,r['cells'][2+i],sum(J['tokens_in_waste_by_cause'][x][f] for x in cs))
# throttled
